questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Batch inference” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.answer_key: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.explanation: Batch inference: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Latency and throughput”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm evaluation/inference mode, input validation, output postprocessing, versioned artifacts, and eager-versus-exported output agreement.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: confirm evaluation/inference mode, input validation, output postprocessing, versioned artifacts, and eager-versus-exported output agreement.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm evaluation/inference mode, input validation, output postprocessing, versioned artifacts, and eager-versus-exported output agreement.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Reducing unnecessary preprocessing costs”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not expose arbitrary file loading or accept unlimited request sizes in an inference endpoint.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not expose arbitrary file loading or accept unlimited request sizes in an inference endpoint.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not expose arbitrary file loading or accept unlimited request sizes in an inference endpoint.
